items.reason: SVG is included in the image whitelist (lib/file_helper.rb:31), so the new loop rewrites oversized SVG uploads in place (app/controllers/uploads_controller.rb:64–67). That invokes ImageMagick’s raster resize pipeline (app/models/optimized_image.rb:126–133), which does not preserve the original vector content, before Upload.create_for parses the file as SVG (app/models/upload.rb:63–66). This introduces a bug for oversized SVG uploads.
